desc: [UPSTREAM + paired static decode] Track explicit T6040 ATC PHY + SN201202x HPM support. The 25F84 AppleT6040TypeCPhy kext now byte-proves the full 44-bank map: profiles 0-3 match atc-phy0-3 ADT reg[] order 44/44, and raw tunables encode bank in bits 31:27 plus signed 27-bit offset. Right-port USB2 HOST is reg[4]+0x8, mask 0x7003/value 0x3, identical to DFLT, so replaying it alone is not a useful test. Ticket 063 proved DART+xHCI root hubs but no child. Remaining implementation blockers are the direct eUSB2 sequence, Apple SPMI Gen4 controller, SN201202x attach/role/orientation/VBUS/repeater path, connector graph, and reviewed ownership/rollback. No SPMI or live PHY writes are authorized. Exact host-only proof: done/2026-07-24-t6040-atcphy-kext-bank-map.md; upstream checkpoint: done/2026-07-23-t6040-atcphy-upstream-checkpoint.md.
